judge.same_model_caveat: RESULTS must state that the pilot judge and the pilot generator are the same model. The user visual verdict remains authoritative.

exit.rule: Passing all 5 of U1-U5 is a mandatory v4 exit criterion.
exit.intake_exclusion: pilot-user-requests.md records that U3 and U4 stay excluded (E3) in this pilot: scope is not expanded now and will eventually be covered. Both facts are recorded. This draft does not drop or add a criterion to reconcile them.

omitted: Counts and clocks from the previous template are not criteria. They are not values in the cited sources.
